I actually decided to dress up slightly for my home office today too—threw on a collared cotton shirt with buttons and a pair of slim-fit twill trousers.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Yes, actually! I'm going to whip up a spicy Thai coconut-milk stew with blocks of bean curd and green chilies. I've been wanting to try making this ever since that cooking class we took, and it fits perfectly with my pescatarian diet.

turns.text: Thanks! It should be a cozy night. I'm looking forward to just relaxing and spinning a few more of those old records. Talk to you tomorrow!
